skill_name: Write a short story that starts when someone enters an abandoned house
workflow: Dave entered the abandoned house with caution. He had heard about its mysterious past and was not sure what he would find. He took a step inside the doorway and looked around. Dust covered the floor, and it was dimly lit. He stepped further into the house and heard a strange noise coming from the back room. He crept closer, trying to stay quiet.
